name: yas
description: glass webbing inside the depth: a whirl lit from within, gold at the core through teal to deep blue at the edges, translucent sheets whose bright rims crowd onto the creases, sweeping strands and a fine scratch over everything
reuses: the style compositor, its palette and glow layers, and the add, screen and normal blends
field smooth as the radial palette's warp, and a glow on radial (screened warm white) so the core is lit whatever the map
field de (the exterior distance estimate): the cavities darkened, the glow along the filaments, and the scooped shells around each cavity
field trap_cross (the Pickover stalk): the long sweeping strands
field smooth: a second set of shells, the arms' own
the leveled spend with the rank transfer (Spend::measure), now also cutting a sheet's steps
the floating_on_dreams round's lesson: the tone pass holds the reference's lightness at every location
adds: channel radial: how near a sample is to a point of the frame, so hue and brightness can fall away from a core
layer sheet: a channel cut into steps, each a faint scooped face under a bright rim, painting the stack beneath by default
member warp on a palette layer: a second channel's rank bends where on the map the first lands, so the radial hue follows the arms instead of drawing a target with maps not in lightness order
member invert on every channel: the position read from the other end
style tone: per-frame tonal normalisation of the composite to a median and a p10 lightness
